effect_description_eng:
＜Overclock ([Puppet] Trait)＞ (At the end of your turn, by deleting 1 of your Tokens or other [Puppet] trait Digimon, this Digimon attacks a player without suspending.)
 [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [Puppet] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your Tokens or other [Puppet] trait trait Digimon, prevent it from leaving.
